thread:
maya: FYI - after the global unpin this morning, eu-west-1 is throwing a bunch of "Unsupported kernel for quantized op" errors for llama3q-8b-quant. us-west canary looks fine.

deploy-bot: deploybot: detected runtime-model mismatch in region eu-west-1. Pin suggestion: runtime=3.2.1 for eu-west-1. See /pins.

anna: Can we do a region-scoped soft-pin instead of a global rollback? Keep traffic routed but force runtime 3.2.1 in eu-west for now. :thinking_face:

tom_sre: I pulled logs from one of the failing nodes:
```
2026-03-19T10:12:02Z infer[pid=4321]: ERROR KernelSelection: no compatible kernel for op GroupQuantize in sequence-length 2048
2026-03-19T10:12:02Z infer[pid=4321]: OOM while allocating 1.2GB
```

kyle_ops: If we soft-pin regionally we should schedule a short maintenance window and drain affected pools. Propose Thu 03:00 UTC (low traffic). I'll prep a drain + rollback playbook.

jess_prodeng: If we need to avoid customer impact, we can fallback routing to the stable model variant (llama3q-8b-v2) while infra stabilizes. That buys time for a proper fix.

maya: deploy-bot — can you apply a regional pin? Something like:
```
/deploybot set-pin runtime=3.2.1 region=eu-west-1 reason="kernel mismatch for quant models"
```

deploy-bot: command accepted. Creating pin ticket RN-4532 and applying soft pin to eu-west-1. Note: cross-region dependency check flagged SDK >= 1.14 required for runtime 3.2.1.

anna: SDK dependency — do we have any customers pinned to older SDKs in eu-west? If yes, that could break.

tom_sre: Quick grep across deployments shows ~4 orgs using sdk=1.12 in eu-west. Those clients might see errors if runtime behavior changes. Recommend we do routing fallback for those tenants or coordinate a targeted SDK update.

jess_prodeng: I'll draft release notes and an admin notification explaining the soft-pin and the SDK requirement. Also adding a customer-facing fallback note for enterprise accounts.

kyle_ops: I've added the maintenance window and the rollback steps to the runbook: https://go.redwood/runbooks/pin-unpin (see section "regional soft-pins"). Also flagged the queue for node drains.

anna: I'll open a small SDK shim PR to tolerate the kernel selection difference, but that may take a day to land. If shim won't be ready, we should keep the regional pin until SDK bump is rolled.

maya: Agreed. Plan: 1) soft-pin eu-west-1 to runtime=3.2.1 (done), 2) route affected tenants to stable model variant as fallback, 3) anna works SDK shim PR, 4) re-evaluate after canary 24h. Everyone OK?

tom_sre: +1. Also adding a metric alert to catch the same error string so we can auto-escalate if it spikes.

deploy-bot: pin RN-4532 applied. Canary status: 10% traffic in eu-west-1 -> monitoring enabled. Will post updates to this thread.

jess_prodeng: I'll post to #customers-enterprise and schedule a brief note for account execs.

maya: Thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source. If deploy-bot posts any failures, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
